homepage.body:
HomeCommunityHow It WorksFor BusinessBlogFAQ
    Log InGet Started
    Earn With Your Connection

    You Are the Internet.Share Your Unused Bandwidth

    The internet is broken — less open, less private, and more restricted than it should be. By running a node and sharing your connection, you help build a better, freer internet — and earn for your contribution. No technical skills required.

    Sign Up For FreeDownload Chrome Extension

    Platforms & Operating Systems

    • Windows
    • macOS
    • Linux
    • Android
    • Docker
    • Raspberry Pi
    How It Works

    How MystNodes Works

    MystNodes works by running a lightweight node on your device that shares unused bandwidth with the Mysterium Network protocol in exchange for rewards.

    1

    Download

    Download and install the MystNodes app on your device in under five minutes.

    2

    Run Your Node

    Your node connects to the Mysterium Network protocol and starts sharing unused bandwidth automatically.

    3

    Share Bandwidth

    The network routes traffic through your node, isolated from your personal browsing. You choose with whom you share your bandwidth.

    4

    Earn Rewards

    You earn rewards based on how much bandwidth you share and how consistently your node stays online. No minimum withdrawal.

    Network

    A Growing Global Network

    Real-time data from thousands of active nodes worldwide.

    Providers

    45k

    People sharing bandwidth

    Network Traffic

    2.82 PB

    Data routed through nodes

    Countries

    104

    Participating worldwide

    Network Uptime

    100%

    Always-on decentralized

    Data last updated: September 2026

    Use Cases

    Built For Everyone

    MystNodes runs on everyday devices and everyday people. Whether you want to add capacity, protect your privacy, or build on the network, there's a place for you.

    Passive Earning

    Monetize idle bandwidth by running a node on your device or server. You earn MYST tokens while your hardware does the work.

    Online Privacy

    Browse the web without surveillance. No logs, no trackers, no data harvesting.

    Unrestricted Access

    Reach content from anywhere through a global network of residential and data center nodes.

    Sign Up For FreeDownload Chrome Extension
    For Business

    MystNodes for Business

    Leverage MystNodes SDK, a powerful monetization solution, to start generating revenue in just minutes. Let’s build your app’s potential together.

    Start Here

    • Earn Extra Revenue

      Harness the MystNodes SDK to unlock a new source of income for your app while keeping user satisfaction intact.

    • Ad-Free SDK

      The MystNodes SDK is completely ad-free, ensuring a seamless and uninterrupted experience for app users.

    • Free and Easy Integration

      Enhance your app’s performance and privacy with a free, seamless SDK integration — no costs to buy, maintain, or worry about future monthly fees.

    Passive Income

    Monetise Your Network Connection

    Run a node on any device and earn rewards proportional to the bandwidth you contribute, with transparent payouts and real-time analytics.

    • Passive income from idle resources.
    • Real-time earnings dashboard.
    • Weekly automated payouts.
    Start Earning

    Join the Community

    Connect with node runners worldwide on Discord, Telegram, and X, and earn more by inviting others.

    Refer a friend and earn 5% of their rewards every month.
    Join Discord Follow on X Join TelegramSign Up For Free
